PENNY FEVER · POCKET HARBOUR TEST

Not a ghost race.
A little collection.

Press and hold in the water just behind the Little Sailboat. The jet pushes it away from your finger — that’s the water-gun trick, in her harbour.

Scoop the floating treasures from the 160-piece book. At the golden berth, release the jet and hold the anchor to settle them into the pocket.

Keyboard: arrows or WASD to steer · Space to anchor · P to pause.

CHOOSE YOUR VOYAGE

Local prototype in Marina’s booth. Catalogue treasures are shown for feel only; Your pocket still holds the first 17 runtime items. No coins, prizes or progress are saved.

MARINA’S CAPTAIN’S NOTES

Give it a little nudge.

  1. Hold in the water behind the Little Sailboat, within about three boat-lengths. The spray pushes it away from you.
  2. Move the jet around the boat to steer. Let go between bursts to refill the water tank.
  3. Pick up all three floating treasures. Any order is fine.
  4. Bring them to the golden berth at the top. Release the jet, then hold ⚓ Hold to moor until the ring completes.

With a keyboard, focus the water and use arrows / WASD. Hold Space to anchor. Bumps are harmless; you can always try again.

The second and third voyages add gates, a ferry and a current. The pale dotted shoreline marks the navigable water.
